samples.title: Beantwortung der Frage: Was ist Aufklärung?
samples.author: Immanuel Kant

provenance.licence: Public domain. All header, footer and licence text of the distributing site and every reference to its trademark are removed, as its licence permits for public-domain text distributed without the trademark.
edits: Kept only the lines from the title 'Beantwortung der Frage: Was ist Aufklärung?' to the end of Kant's footnote [1]; removed everything before (header, 'Produced by' line, bracketed transcription notes) and after (the 1913 'Lesarten' apparatus, the bracketed list of corrected lines, the footer).
Removed the transcriber's emphasis markers '=' (letter-spaced in the original) and '_' (italic in the original); no word was changed, added or reordered.
Converted line endings to LF; editorial line breaks and indentation kept.

samples.title: The Kybalion, Chapter II: The Seven Hermetic Principles
samples.author: Three Initiates

provenance.edition: The Kybalion: A Study of the Hermetic Philosophy of Ancient Egypt and Greece, by Three Initiates, Chicago: The Yogi Publication Society; the eBook reproduces the printing marked 'COPYRIGHT 1912' (first published 1908); eBook #14209, release 2004-11-29, updated 2024-10-28
provenance.licence: Public domain. All header, footer and licence text of the distributing site and every reference to its trademark are removed, as its licence permits for public-domain text distributed without the trademark.
edits: Kept only Chapter II, from the line 'CHAPTER II' to the line before 'CHAPTER III'.

Added Markdown syntax only: '# ' before 'CHAPTER II', '## ' before 'THE SEVEN HERMETIC PRINCIPLES', '### ' before the seven sub-headings '1.  The Principle of Mentalism' to '7.  The Principle of Gender'.

The indented seven-item enumeration became an ordered list (indentation removed); the other indented passages (quotations from The Kybalion) became block quotes ('> ' replaces the four-space indentation).
Converted line endings to LF; no word was changed, added or reordered.
